prompt: Tiling ground terrain texture: a light, patchy dusting of fine grey ash over scorched dirt, fire passed through fast and did not linger. The bare ground shows through in places -- cracked, blackened dirt and pale ash sit side by side, no single layer hides the other. Fine soot specks scattered unevenly, a few wisps of ash drifted by wind. Must tile seamlessly edge-to-edge. Painterly vanilla-RimWorld terrain art style, top-down, muted warm-grey and charcoal palette. Full-bleed opaque seamless tiling texture filling the entire canvas edge to edge -- no transparency, no isolated subject, no vignette, no border; every edge must wrap to its opposite edge.
style_notes: PYRELANDS_WEATHER_SCAR_ART_1: rung 1 of 4 (AshLadder.xml RM_FE_Ash_Trace). Owner verdict 2026-09-18: ash rungs read as tinted RoughHewnRock, commissioned dedicated ash-scar art. TerrainDef applies its own <color> tint on top (150,145,138,140) so keep the base texture's own value range mid-light, not pre-darkened.
